_disclaimer: Default values are calibrated against the memory profile of the FOLIO module sidecar, because folio-secure-store-proxy has no reference bugfest deployment yet. See ADR-0013 (Module configuration management) for the governance model behind this file. Resource values and JVM limits must be adjusted to the target host capacity once real load data is available.

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the folio-secure-store-proxy container

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the folio-secure-store-proxy container in MiB

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation (soft limit) for the folio-secure-store-proxy container in MiB

java.name: xmx
java.description: Maximum Java heap size; the proxy only forwards secret reads and writes to the backing store and by default keeps at most 500 cached entries, so a small heap as for the sidecar is appropriate

java.name: xms
java.description: Initial Java heap size; set to half of xmx to reduce startup GC pressure

java.name: UseZGC
java.description: Use ZGC low-pause collector; preferred for a proxy-shaped workload where tail latency matters more than throughput

deployment.description: The proxy is stateless apart from an in-memory entry cache, so several replicas can run behind a load balancer; two are recommended because every module that reads secrets through it depends on its availability. The cache is local to each replica and entries live for 24h: a secret written or deleted through one replica is refreshed in that replica only, and cache invalidation through the cache admin endpoints also applies to a single replica. Clients must present a certificate whose CN is mapped to a role in the packaged cert-role-mappings (user.fssp.com or admin.fssp.com).

EnvVars.name: SSP_TLS_KEYSTORE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Path to the key store holding the server certificate and private key of the mTLS listener. The proxy runs only in mTLS mode and fails to start without it.

EnvVars.name: SSP_TLS_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password of the server key store.

EnvVars.name: SSP_TLS_KEYSTORE_KEY_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password of the private key entry inside the server key store, when it differs from the key store password.

EnvVars.name: SSP_TLS_KEYSTORE_FILE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Type of the server key store file (e.g. PKCS12, JKS).

EnvVars.name: SSP_TLS_KEYSTORE_PROVIDER
EnvVars.description: Security provider of the server key store (e.g. SUN).

EnvVars.name: SSP_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Path to the trust store with the certificates of the clients allowed to connect; client certificates are mandatory, so the proxy fails to start without it.

EnvVars.name: SSP_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password of the trust store.

EnvVars.name: SSP_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_FILE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Type of the trust store file (e.g. PKCS12, JKS).

EnvVars.name: SSP_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PROVIDER
EnvVars.description: Security provider of the trust store (e.g. SUN).

EnvVars.name: QUARKUS_HTTP_SSL_PORT
EnvVars.description: HTTPS port of the secrets API. Plain HTTP is disabled.

EnvVars.name: QUARKUS_MANAGEMENT_PORT
EnvVars.description: Port of the management interface that serves the health endpoints under /admin/health over plain HTTP; use it for container health checks and keep it off public networks.

EnvVars.name: ROOT_LOG_LEVEL
EnvVars.description: Root log level of the Quarkus logging framework.

EnvVars.name: SSP_LOG_LEVEL
EnvVars.description: Log level of the org.folio.ssp package. DEBUG also logs retrieved and stored secret values, so do not use it in production.

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTS
EnvVars.description: Additional JVM options for the folio-secure-store-proxy process (heap sizing, GC, agent flags, etc.)

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Backing secret store the proxy reads from and writes to: AWS_SSM, VAULT or EPHEMERAL. The code default is EPHEMERAL, an in-memory store that loses all secrets on restart and is meant for development only.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_REGION
EnvVars.description: AWS region of the SSM client. Required when SECRET_STORE_TYPE=AWS_SSM.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_USE_IAM
EnvVars.description: Use the IAM role of the running task for SSM authorization instead of explicit credentials. Applies when SECRET_STORE_TYPE=AWS_SSM.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_FIPS_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: When true, the AWS SDK uses the AWS FIPS endpoints. Applies when SECRET_STORE_TYPE=AWS_SSM; set it when the AWS FIPS endpoints must be used.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_ADDRESS
EnvVars.description: Address of the HashiCorp Vault server. Required when SECRET_STORE_TYPE=VAULT.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_TOKEN
EnvVars.description: Token used to access Vault (sourced from secret store). Required when SECRET_STORE_TYPE=VAULT.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_ENABLE_SSL
EnvVars.description: Whether to use SSL when connecting to Vault. Applies when SECRET_STORE_TYPE=VAULT.

EnvVars.name: QUARKUS_CACHE_CAFFEINE__ENTRY_CACHE__INITIAL_CAPACITY
EnvVars.description: Initial capacity of the secret entry cache (quarkus.cache.caffeine."entry-cache".initial-capacity).

EnvVars.name: QUARKUS_CACHE_CAFFEINE__ENTRY_CACHE__MAXIMUM_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of secrets held in the entry cache (quarkus.cache.caffeine."entry-cache".maximum-size). Raise it when more distinct secrets are read than fit in the cache.

EnvVars.name: QUARKUS_CACHE_CAFFEINE__ENTRY_CACHE__EXPIRE_AFTER_WRITE
EnvVars.description: How long a secret stays in the entry cache after it was loaded (quarkus.cache.caffeine."entry-cache".expire-after-write). A secret changed directly in the backing store becomes visible only after this time or after the cache entry is invalidated.
